thread:
Aisha (CS): Heads up — ModoHealth (payg pilot) just requested a short-term config change: temporary higher QPS for Brazil (sa-east-1), IP allowlist for their NATs, and edge routing into sa-east-1. They're concerned about onboarding velocity; renewal convo flagged as at-risk if they don't launch next week. Posting customer details and ask.

Kenji (Networking): Can you drop the exact CIDRs? Any certs/SSO or GSLB entries needed? Also what's the requested duration?

Aisha (CS): Customer provided two public NAT ranges: 200.23.45.0/24 and 200.23.46.0/24. Request: increase to 2,000 req/min sustained for 7 days, then revert to 500 req/min. They also asked for a regional peering preference for sa-east-1 to shave ~80ms off RTT. They want auto-revoke after 7d.

Ruben (Account): Renewal POC: I'm following up but can't promise renewal unless we get them unblocked this week. Recommend 7d trial + metric check on day 3 (latency, error-rate, token spend). Can we put a hard cap to protect against runaway billing? :eyes:

Kenji (Networking): We can add the CIDRs to the customer allowlist and create a temporary rate profile. Peering needs infra sign-off. Proposed quick config: ```rate_profile: modohealth-temp\nregion: sa-east-1\nmax_rpm: 2000\nmin_rpm: 500\nexpiry: 2026-04-10T14:00Z\nauto_revoke: true``` Will implement ACL + rate rule as a first step.

Marta (Onboarding): I'll run the enablement demo Wed 09:00 BRT. Please send SDK keys scoped to the temp profile and some sample prompt sets for the interactive demo. I'll capture any evals they want and add to the onboarding tracker.

infra-bot: Ticket #CS-4821 created: "ModoHealth — LATAM peering + temp rate lift". Assigned: Kenji. State: awaiting infra-review.

ops-oncall: Capacity check: 2k rpm should be fine for redwood-llama-s-13b but depends on concurrency and seq len. If they're using 1k token windows with 50 concurrent sessions, we may need to funnel to a dedicated pool or apply batching. What model are they on?

Aisha (CS): They're on redwood-llama-s-13b for now. Primary goal: interactive latency for web UI. If perf gets worse than SLA, we'll notify them and suggest a quantized or lower-parameter variant as fallback.

Kenji (Networking): Proceeding: I'll apply the ACL entries and stage the rate profile with a hard cap. Plan: deploy ACL + ratelimit, enable auto-revoke at 2026-04-10T14:00Z, and add a short rollback window. Will post confirmation and the ACL ticket link when done.

Ruben (Account): Great — I'll tell ModoHealth that a 7d temp lift is tentatively approved pending infra changes. I'll also ask finance to set a spend alert at $750/day for the pilot.

Aisha (CS): Thanks team. @Kenji please ping me the ACL ticket link when it's live. I'll update the renewal playbook entry: "ModoHealth — status: temp lift pending; 7d trial; enablement Wed 09:00 BRT; renewal at risk if not launched by Apr 15". Capturing feedback and next steps here.
